title: automation: a flow started through the REST or action door carries the caller's positions and permission sets but not their posture rung
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia

Found by the #28070 card thread (PR #28098) and filed by the `domain:server` seat. Outside that PR's surface. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is wrong

PR #28098 makes a `runAs: 'user'` run whose grants the engine resolves (a record-change run, the segment after an approval decision) carry its user's posture rung (`ExecutionContext.posture`, ADR-0095 D2/D3). A run started through a door that forwards the caller's already-resolved grants does not get one:

- the REST door, `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` (`buildAutomationContext`, ~L204-205), and
- the action door, `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` (the flow action's `automation.execute` context, ~L2077-2078),

both copy `ec.positions` / `ec.permissions` (and `tenantId`, `locale`), never `ec.posture`. Because the context carries its own grants, run setup does not re-resolve them, so the run has no rung. A platform administrator's manually-run flow is therefore served organization ledger rows only, not the deployment-level ones their request is served. It fails closed (fewer rows, never more).

## Expected

A door-started run carries the rung its caller's request carries, the same way it carries the caller's positions and permission sets. Forwarding it reaches `AutomationContext` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`), or the door's extra-key shape, so the route is triage's.

Related: #28070, PR #28098 (its changeset's "Still without a rung" bullet and `record-view-auditing.mdx` name this case).
